description: Defines a ThemeState class managing light/dark/system UI themes, extending ChangeNotifier for state management in a Flutter app.

classes.name: ThemeState
classes.description: Manages the application's theme mode (light, dark, system) with change notifications.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.description: Sets the theme mode and notifies listeners if changed.
